doc: Measured identities of the two toolchains verify_decomp.py can drive: `stock` under EE_ROOTFS (the independent, unpatched ee-gcc 2.96) and `contract` under <upstream>/.work/toolchains (the decomp's pinned cc1 + la29 ee-as). tools/doctor.py compares these hashes with the files on disk (the stock section; the contract section records the fsv3 pair measured here, the upstream has since moved to an fsv8 cc1, which verify_decomp.py now reads from the upstream's config/toolchain-identity.json). `root_measured` names the root by its environment variable or default, never a machine path. Regenerate by hand when a payload changes; `pinned_sha256` comes from config/toolchain-identity.json.

cc1.version: gcc 2.96-ee-001003-1 (cc1), locally patched: realconv + lp7 + fsv3

cpp0.note: byte-identical to the stock cpp0, and unused: the kit preprocesses on the host with clang -E -P -DSKIP_ASM (see README.md, Preprocessing)

ee-as.version: GNU assembler 2.9-ee-991111, locally patched: memmove + vsqrt + nolabel + laimm
ee-as.pin: rebuilt-from-source (differs from the pin; the TU gate accepts it under XENO_TOOLCHAIN_ALLOW=ee-as-la29-vsqrt)
ee-as.runs_via: the box's own libc (needs GLIBC_2.34; the rootfs glibc 2.19 cannot load it)
